steps.result:
1	# triage.py
2	
3	A module that sorts a customer support ticket for an online store into one category by asking a language model. It is one component of a larger program, so it takes the API client as an argument and never creates one. Use only the Python standard library, and don't import the `anthropic` package.
4	
5	## Constants
6	
7	- `CATEGORIES` is the tuple `("billing", "login", "shipping", "other")`.
8	- `MODEL` is `"claude-sonnet-5-5"`.
9	- `SYSTEM_PROMPT` is exactly `"You sort customer support tickets for an online store. Reply with exactly one word from this list: billing, login, shipping, other."`
10	
11	## answer_text(reply)
12	
13	`reply` has a `content` list of blocks, and each block has a `type`. Return the `text` of every block whose type is `"text"`, joined with nothing between them. Ignore every other block, since a reply can carry `thinking` blocks, whose text is empty.
14	
15	## parse_category(text)
16	
17	Turn a reply into a category, or flag it. Lowercase `text`, then remove every whitespace and punctuation character (Python's `string.whitespace` and `string.punctuation`) from both ends. Return the result if it is one of `CATEGORIES`, and otherwise return the string `"unrecognized"`.
18	
19	The cleanup forgives formatting, so `" Billing.\n"` is `"billing"`. It forgives nothing else, so `"refund"`, a sentence, or a reply that names two categories is `"unrecognized"`, and the caller decides what to do with it. This is the module's only function for reading a reply.
20	
21	## triage(client, ticket, model=MODEL)
22	
23	Raise `ValueError` if `ticket` is empty or only whitespace, without calling the client. Otherwise call `client.messages.create` with exactly these keyword arguments and no others:
24	
25	    model=model, max_tokens=1024, system=SYSTEM_PROMPT,
26	    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": ticket}]
27	
28	Pass the ticket unchanged. Return `parse_category(answer_text(reply))`.
